javaMethod.description: The Java native method (Lpkg/C;->name(sig)ret); for a registered entry whose class is not known, ?->name(sig)ret.

library.description: The library entry (lib/<abi>/libname.so); null for an unresolved method.

symbol.description: The exported symbol (Java_pkg_C_name, or the overload form with __ and the mangled parameters).

address.description: Virtual address of the native function in the library.

kind.description: static_export (bound by its exported name), registered (a RegisterNatives table entry), unresolved (a native method with no export or table entry), or export_only (a Java_ export with no native method in the DEX code).

confidence.description: registered entries: how the class was found: class_string (the FindClass name in the function that passes the table), name_and_signature (the only native method with that name and signature), or unknown.

table.description: registered entries: virtual address of the table.

libraries.description: The libraries read that have Java_ exports, JNI_OnLoad or RegisterNatives tables, with their counts.
